name: fish-chips-order
title_zh: 炸鱼薯条店扫码点单，钓上鱼就免单的POS一体系统
tagline_zh: 顾客扫码点单、后厨POS接单、钓鱼小游戏攒积分换折扣——三端一体的店用系统，改菜单不用重启服务。
tagline_en: Scan, order, play a mini fishing game, earn discounts—POS and customer app stay in sync. Built for one shop.
desc_en: QR scan-to-order system for a fish & chips shop, with POS integration and an AI ordering agent ("Order & Track") that includes a fishing mini-game rewards mechanic. Use this skill whenever building, extending, or debugging any part of the fish-chips-order system (backend, customer-facing web order app, POS adapter, or gamification).
why_zh: 不是套壳点单页：订单状态机、POS适配器、游戏奖励引擎三层解耦，改游戏规则不动收款逻辑。
why_en: Three decoupled layers—order state machine, POS adapter, reward engine—so you can tweak the game without touching payments, or.
limit_zh: 只认这家店的业务模型：单一门店、先付后做、钓鱼奖励只作用于折扣不叠加。没有多店管理、桌台分单、外卖平台对接。
limit_en: Single-store, pay-first model only. No multi-branch, table split, or delivery-platform integration. Fishing rewards apply to discounts only, not.
title_en: Fish & chips QR ordering with POS sync and a fishing-game.
